directive.title: Wing skin crack inspection
directive.applies_to: All Boeing 737-800 aircraft, serial numbers 28000 through 31500 inclusive, regardless of operator.
directive.compliance_action: Detailed visual inspection of upper wing skin at WS 95-110 within 600 flight hours.

directive.title: Engine HPC blade inspection
directive.applies_to: All Airbus A320 family aircraft equipped with CFM56-5B engines, all serial numbers.
directive.compliance_action: Borescope inspection of HPC stage 3 blades within 200 cycles.

unmatched_criteria_must_include: engine type does not match CFM56-5B

directive.title: Cabin O2 generator life-limit revision
directive.applies_to: All Airbus A220 aircraft incorporating SB A220-35-001 Rev 02 or later.
directive.compliance_action: Replace cabin O2 generators within 1500 flight hours per revised life-limit.
